_aMetadata._sSnippet: Version bump due to notable feature update.Congratulations to the Kosei crew, for having both of you...

_aRecords._sText:
Version bump due to notable feature update.

Congratulations to the Kosei crew, for having both of your representatives be the first romance routes (hopefully) properly finally implemented in this mod.

For a much more detailed writeup on what's currently implemented for Yusuke's romance stuff and how to unlock it, go to this blog post specifically intended for Yusuke's romance route stuff in this mod. I posted it as a separate blog post in order to avoid running into character limits in the main mod post.

Meanwhile, Chihaya's Confidant events have been adjusted, and her romance route has been blocked off, as I have stated for months that the romance options in this mod are what I initially stated they are, going back years, even. If you want to keep the Chihaya romance route, then an add-on mod needs to be made with the appropriate file changes to "overlap" this base mod. There are guides such as the text editing guide, for starters.

The changes made should not affect save data, so you should be able to get her romance stuff while this mod is disabled. If you disabled this mod and are still running into issues with Chihaya's romance content not triggering, that's a bug. I specifically tried to avoid overwriting flags and Confidant slots, and modified checks and surface-level data instead.
